verdict.rationale: Algolia's docs point users to an official Crawler that turns web pages into records, and to integrations for Shopify, Adobe Commerce, BigCommerce, commercetools, Salesforce B2C Commerce and Zendesk. Algolia also manages the schedule, retries and transformations from the dashboard without deploying code, and hands-on users report low-effort DocSearch/crawler setups. One user notes the crawler can time out on slow-loading pages and miss content. Missing for 10: connectors for generic databases/data warehouses or other non-commerce sources, in-depth crawler configuration documentation in the pack, a fix or documented mitigation for crawler timeouts on slow pages.
